### Executive Summary

Cryptocurrency hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor has confirmed a data breach affecting a third-party email provider. Following the compromise, scammers are actively targeting hundreds of thousands of cryptocurrency owners. 

The incident exposes user contact information, leaving impacted customers at elevated risk for targeted phishing operations and social engineering attacks. Cyberpent is monitoring for further updates regarding the scope of the exposure.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

The root cause of the incident is attributed to a data breach at a third-party email service provider used by Trezor. Specific details regarding the initial access vector or vulnerabilities exploited at the provider have not yet been confirmed.

The technical impact involves the unauthorized exposure of contact information associated with Trezor users. Threat actors are utilizing this data to launch malicious campaigns aimed at compromising user accounts and cryptocurrency assets.

### Mitigation & IOCs

Cryptocurrency owners and Trezor users are advised to exercise extreme caution when reviewing emails purporting to come from Trezor or associated services. Users should avoid clicking on unverified links, entering seed phrases on digital interfaces, or responding to unsolicited communications. Specific vendor mitigations have not yet been detailed in the available source material.
